people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: who strum on the strings of a harp; who invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;
translations.bsb: You improvise songs on the harp like David and invent your own musical instruments.
translations.kjv: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;
translations.asv: that sing idle songs to the sound of the viol; that invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;
